Print a styled H2 header

Source: R/utils-logging.R
print_h2.Rd

Prints a single-line horizontal rule with a split layout. The main text appears on the left (bold, colored), and optional info appears on the right (italic, grey).

Usage

print_h2(
  text,
  info = NULL,
  line_color = "cyan",
  text_color = "cyan",
  info_color = "grey80"
)

Arguments

text

Character string. The text for the left side of the header.

info

Character string (Optional). Text for the right side, displayed in brackets.

line_color

Character string. Color of the horizontal line. Defaults to "cyan".

text_color

Character string. Color of the left-side text. Defaults to "cyan".

info_color

Character string. Color of the right-side info text. Defaults to "grey60".
